decisions.reason: As a dedicated sensor module publicly launched for the firm's modular system, it reflects visible investment and can plausibly be justified as part of a growing sensing portfolio, so management is likely to continue it.
Because it explicitly replaced an earlier version, the firm has already committed the product line and is likely to persist with the updated module rather than reverse course soon.

Although less prominently presented, a CAN bus interface fits the industrial electronics context in Germany and the firm's platform logic, which supports continued commitment despite any mixed results.

A CO2 sensor module received its own product presentation and sits close to the firm's announced sensor direction, so sunk development effort and public commitment make withdrawal within a year unlikely.
